scope: Operations application only; ordinary KikiTalk Apple accounts remain separate.

response.publicKey: W3C PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions: residentKey=required, userVerification=required, attestation=none, ES256
W3C PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions: rpId=kiki.group, userVerification=required; discoverable, no identifying credential list

response.userHandle: Base64URL of server allocated user handle

response.account: Same account object as session response; permissions read from DB on every request

body.name: Trimmed display name, 1-32 characters, no controls; duplicates allowed

dashboards.response: Existing account-admin-api-contract dashboard JSON; source kiki.group
Existing admin-api-contract dashboard JSON; source furby.top, service.id remains voice-lab

authorization: All new accounts have zero grants, including the first account. No public grant API or first-user bootstrap. Manual server CLI requires immutable account ID and exact current name. Revocation checked per request. Missing name cannot access a dashboard. Session is stored hashed and never accepted as an Apple business or legacy administrator session.

errors.403: Authenticated but no requested grant; client clears only denied dashboard and refreshes me
errors.409: Conflict or one-use transaction consumed; restart Passkey ceremony
errors.503: Service unavailable; do not invent data

voiceGateway.keySeparation: Dedicated fresh high entropy secret; never reuse business account-voice key, LiveKit, Apple, or legacy passphrase
voiceGateway.signature: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, UTF8(newline join([account-voice-ops-v2, POST, /internal/admin/v2/dashboard, timestamp, nonce, SHA256(rawBody)])))
voiceGateway.nonce: Random 16-byte lowercase hex, durably consumed once for 61 seconds
voiceGateway.network: Nginx permits only account server 43.138.219.160; still requires signature. Reject query, Authorization header, redirects, and any body other than exact UTF8 {}. No account name/ID or application Bearer forwarded.

productionConfiguration.bothServers: ADMIN_AUTH_MODE=passkey disables every legacy admin/v1 login and Bearer; no password fallback
productionConfiguration.account: OPS_BRIDGE_SECRET only on servers, RP/origin fixed; passkey identity namespace independent of ordinary accounts
productionConfiguration.voice: No operations identity/ACL copy; internal signed aggregate dashboard only

recovery: Synced Passkeys use platform credential management. If a Passkey is lost, a newly registered identity has no grants and requires separate human verification and explicit reauthorization. No name-only account recovery.
